title: Card declined at point of sale
content: If your PrimaBank debit or credit card is declined, try these steps: (1) Check your account balance in the mobile app — you may have insufficient funds. (2) Verify the card is not locked — go to Card Management in the app to check status. (3) Check if you have exceeded your daily spending limit ($2,500 default for debit, varies for credit). You can temporarily increase your daily limit in the app or by calling 1-800-PRIMA. (4) If you are traveling, confirm you set a travel notice — transactions from unexpected locations may be blocked by fraud detection. Set a travel notice in the app under Card Management > Travel Notice. (5) Check the card expiration date — expired cards are automatically declined. (6) If none of these apply, call 1-800-PRIMA for assistance. The fraud prevention team may have placed a hold that requires your verbal confirmation to release.

title: Online banking account locked
content: Your PrimaBank Online account is locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts. To unlock: (1) Wait 30 minutes and try again — the lockout may expire automatically. (2) Use the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page to reset your password. You will need your account number, Social Security number, and access to your registered email or phone for verification. (3) Call 1-800-PRIMA and verify your identity to have a representative unlock your account immediately. (4) Visit any PrimaBank branch with a valid photo ID for in-person assistance. To prevent future lockouts, consider using a password manager and enabling biometric login on the mobile app. If you did not make the failed login attempts, report this to 1-800-PRIMA immediately as it may indicate unauthorized access attempts.

title: Mobile app not working
content: If the PrimaBank mobile app is not working properly, try these steps in order: (1) Force close the app and reopen it. (2) Check your internet connection — the app requires cellular data or WiFi for most features (except viewing cached account information). (3) Update the app to the latest version from the App Store or Google Play — outdated versions may have compatibility issues. (4) Clear the app cache: on Android, go to Settings > Apps > PrimaBank > Storage > Clear Cache. On iOS, delete and reinstall the app. (5) Ensure your phone OS is up to date (requires iOS 15+ or Android 10+). (6) If the app crashes on launch, try restarting your phone. (7) If problems persist, check primabank.com/status for known service disruptions, or call 1-800-PRIMA for technical support.

title: Fund transfer failed
content: If your fund transfer failed, check these common causes: (1) Insufficient funds — ensure your available balance (not current balance) covers the transfer amount plus any pending transactions. (2) Daily transfer limits exceeded — internal transfers are limited to $25,000/day and external transfers to $10,000/day by default. Request a temporary increase through the app or by calling 1-800-PRIMA. (3) Incorrect recipient information — double-check the account number and routing number. Transfers to invalid account numbers are returned within 1-3 business days. (4) External account not verified — new external accounts require micro-deposit verification (two small deposits of $0.01-$0.99 that you must confirm). (5) Scheduled transfer on a weekend or holiday — transfers process on the next business day. (6) If the transfer was deducted from your account but not received by the recipient, contact 1-800-PRIMA with the transfer confirmation number.

title: Suspicious transaction on account
content: If you see a transaction you do not recognize on your PrimaBank account: (1) Check if the merchant name looks different from the store name — many businesses process payments under a parent company or doing-business-as name. (2) Check for pending authorizations — gas stations and hotels often place temporary holds that may appear as charges. (3) Ask other authorized users on the account (joint account holders, authorized signers, supplementary card holders) if they made the transaction. (4) If the transaction is confirmed as unauthorized, call 1-800-PRIMA immediately to report fraud and lock your card. (5) File a dispute through PrimaBank Online under Transactions > Dispute a Transaction, or in the mobile app by tapping the transaction and selecting 'Report a Problem.' PrimaBank will investigate and provide provisional credit within 10 business days for debit card disputes. You have 60 days from the statement date to report unauthorized transactions.
